## Cited Candidate Observations

### OBS-1: Ollama LLM invoked directly in a committed developer script for i18n translation

**File:** [`apps/web/scripts/simple-translate.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/0xfurai-peekaping@742a60d94fdaacc977c09444b651f7cf1c1aab9e/-/blob/apps/web/scripts/simple-translate.js)

**Evidence:**

```javascript
// Line 10
import { Ollama } from "@langchain/ollama";

// Lines 60-63
const llm = new Ollama({
  model: "gpt-oss:20b",
  reasoning: false
});

// Lines 99-107 — invocation at translation time
async function translate(text, targetLanguage) {
  const prompt = `Translate this UI text from English to ${targetLanguage}. Return only the translation, no explanations:\n\n"${text}"`;
  const response = await llm.invoke(prompt);
  return response.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
}
```

**Nature:** A local-execution developer tool that uses `@langchain/ollama` to drive a model named `gpt-oss:20b` (a locally served Ollama model). It reads the canonical English locale file (`en-US.json`), identifies untranslated keys in every other locale JSON file, generates a per-key translation prompt, invokes the LLM, and writes results back. No CI trigger; invoked manually by a developer with `node apps/web/scripts/simple-translate.js`.

**Constraint / configuration details:**
- The prompt is tightly constrained: `"Return only the translation, no explanations"`.
- The `reasoning` field is explicitly set to `false`.
- A 100 ms inter-call delay is inserted to avoid overloading the local API.
- Bot-authored commits are filtered from changelog generation (separate script), but AI-generated locale strings themselves carry no disclosure annotation in the locale JSON files.

**Dependency declaration:** [`apps/web/package.json` L62](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/0xfurai-peekaping@742a60d94fdaacc977c09444b651f7cf1c1aab9e/-/blob/apps/web/package.json?L62) lists `"@langchain/ollama": "^0.2.4"` as a **devDependency**, confirming this is a developer-time tool, not a runtime feature.

- name: Set up Git user
  run: |
